light_setup: UV LED array (365 nm) wrapped around reactor coil
deoxygenation_method: Sparging with inert gas or membrane degasser

streams.reasoning: Chemistry Plan specifies single stream with all reagents dissolved. Concentration 0.1 M from batch input. Flow rate 0.5 mL/min from Engineering Design Calculations Step 3.

mixing_order_reasoning: Chemistry Plan stream_logic indicates all reagents are dissolved together before irradiation. No mixing of separate streams is required.
pre_reactor_steps: Degas carbon tetrachloride solution via sparging with inert gas (N2 or Ar) or membrane degasser to remove oxygen, as radical reactions are oxygen-sensitive (Chemistry Plan).
post_reactor_steps: Collect product stream. Note: Carbon tetrachloride is toxic; ensure proper waste handling.
chemistry_notes: Radical bromination of amino acid derivative. UV light (365 nm) initiates radical chain. Oxygen must be excluded. Single stream simplifies setup. CCl4 is solvent. NBS is bromine source. Flow allows precise residence time control to improve selectivity over batch.

reasoning_per_field.residence_time_min: Engineering Design Calculations Step 2 estimated 12.3 min. Analogy 1 used 3.75 min (48x intensification), Analogy 2 used 1 min (60x). Calculated value is conservative and within range [6.7-24.0] min. Used calculated value for safety/selectivity.
reasoning_per_field.residence_time_basis: Single phase liquid system. Basis is liquid volume / liquid flow.
reasoning_per_field.temperature_C: Batch condition 30 C. Analogy 1 used 20 C, Analogy 2 used 25 C. Maintaining batch temperature to ensure consistent kinetics unless heat transfer issues arise (Calc Step 7 says thermally safe).
reasoning_per_field.BPR_bar: Calculation Step 8 says BPR not required. T=30 C is well below CCl4 bp (76.7 C). No gas generation.
reasoning_per_field.tubing_material: FEP is transparent to UV/Visible light, suitable for photochemistry. Analogy 2 used PFA (also transparent). FEP is standard for flow photochem.
reasoning_per_field.concentration_M: Batch input specifies 0.1 M. Analogy 1 used 0.03 M, Analogy 2 used 0.2 M. 0.1 M is reasonable for radical reactions to balance light penetration and rate.
reasoning_per_field.flow_rate_mL_min: From Engineering Design Calculations Step 3: 0.5 mL/min.
reasoning_per_field.reactor_volume_mL: From Engineering Design Calculations Step 3: 6.15 mL. Derived from tau=12.3 min and Q=0.5 mL/min.
reasoning_per_field.tubing_ID_mm: From Engineering Design Calculations Step 3: 1.00 mm. Suitable for UV penetration and laminar flow.
reasoning_per_field.wavelength_nm: Chemistry Plan recommends 365 nm for UV initiation. Analogy 1/3 used 450 nm (blue LED) for different photocatalysts. 365 nm is appropriate for direct NBS/CCl4 radical initiation.
reasoning_per_field.light_setup: UV LED array required for 365 nm irradiation. Wrapped around coil for uniform exposure.

literature_analogies: Analogy 1: Radical bromination, flow photochem, 48x intensification.
Analogy 2: Photoredox radical substitution, PFA tubing, 60x intensification.
